British International School of Chicago, South Loop

College Counseling

The small counselor-to-student ratio at British International allows for a highly individualized boutique approach to college counseling. Our college counselors draw upon their individual expertise to collaborate - creating a team approach when working with students and families. We empower students with the tools and life skills necessary to have ownership of the college admissions process. The goal is to guide and support students in exploring a broad range of best fit post-secondary options both in the United States and abroad that align with their skills, strengths, and interests. While this can be a stressful time, we prioritize confidence building and encourage self-efficacy and open-mindedness throughout the process.

Meet our Team

Every member of the South Loop team contributes to our reputation as a world-renowned educational institution.

Director of College Counseling

Danika Nowak

Danika Nowak leads the college counseling program.

Danika Nowak Danika has been a college counselor since 2010 and brings a wealth of experience to BISC-SL. She joins us from UWC International School of Asia, Karuizawa which is in Japan. Prior to that she was the Director of College Counseling at the American School of Guatemala, where she each year she worked with over 500 students across their High School and helped to place them in their chosen universities in the US, the UK, Europe and further afield. During her time there she was nominated for the International Career and College Counseling Movement’s Counselor of the Year Award 2023 (Latin America & The Caribbean).

IB Coordinator

Laura Gilmartin

Laura is BISC-SL's IB Coordinator

Laura Gilmartin - IB Coordinator Laura came to South Loop from Fulham Senior School in London as IB Coordinator, Head of English, and TOK Coordinator, she is an experienced international educator and has spent more than seven years working and leading in IB schools. Laura started her career at the highly rated Pimlico Academy in London but has also worked at the English International School of Padua, Italy as IB Coordinator, and at St Paul’s School in Sao Paulo, Brazil in a variety of roles (teacher, Head of Year, and Head of English). Laura has a BA Hons Degree in English and American Literature from the University of Warwick in England and a Masters Degree in English Literature from Newcastle University, England.

College Counseling Approach

Throughout Years 10-13 (Grades 9-12), the college counselors work with students and their families individually and in group settings to discuss and explore a variety of college and career related topics. The college counselors work collaboratively with students and their families to develop an individualized and intentional plan for extracurricular engagement, standardized testing, and college admissions:

  • Year 10 Exploring Strengths & Extra-Curricular Engagement
  • Year 11 Exploring Careers & Summer Enrichment
  • Year 12 Exploring Colleges & University Options
  • Year 13 College Application Support

04

College Counseling Programs

College Visits: Many college and university representatives from the United States and around the world visit BISC-SL each year to share information about their institutions and build relationships with our students and college counselors in our intimate High School Hub. Presentations & Events: From hosting evening presentations to offering standardized testing information sessions, we present a variety of programming each year to facilitate the sharing of college admissions related information and resources. Coffee Chats: The college counselors regularly moderate informal conversations with parents of different year groups on a range of age-specific, college-related topics from College Admissions 101 to Summer Enrichment. Workshops and Panels: Each year we organize a College Kickoff that includes a mock admissions committee meeting, university admissions officer panel, and application strategy panel. In addition, the College Counseling Department hosts a series of interactive panels aimed at different year groups, such as: Alumni, Liberal Arts, Parent & Student and Engagement.
